spans.s: केश m. 1. Hair, K.S.v.68; 2. the hair of the head, R.ii.8, M.ii.211; 3. the mane of a horse or lion; 4. a ray of light; 5. an epithet of Varuṇa; 6. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
केश-अंत m. 1. the tip of a hair; 2. long hair hanging down; 3. cutting of the hair as a religious ceremony, M.ii.65.
केश-उच्चय m. much or handsome hair.
केश-कर्मन् n. dressing or arranging the hair of the head.
केश-कलाप m. a mass of hair.
केश-कीट m. a louse.
केशाकेशि ind. hair to hair, pulling each other’s hair, Yaj.ii.283.
केश-गर्भ m. a braid of hair.
केश-गृहीत a. seized by the hair.
केश-ग्रह m. pulling the hair (cither in amorous sports or in fighting), e.g. रतेषु केशग्रहाः Kad. (the implication being, न विग्रहेषु), Megh.i.50.
केश-ग्रहण n. pulling the hair (cither in amorous sports or in fighting), e.g. रतेषु केशग्रहाः Kad. (the implication being, न विग्रहेषु), Megh.i.50.
केश-घ्न n. morbid baldness.
केश-च्छिद् m. a hairdresser, a barber.
केश-जाह m. the root of a hair.
केश-पक्ष, -पाश, -हस्त m. much (or ornamented) hair, तं केशपाशं प्रसमीक्ष्य कुर्युर्बालप्रियत्वं शिथिलं चमर्यः K.S.i.48, vii.57, (पाशः पक्षश्च हस्तश्च कालापार्थः कचात्परे Am.)
केश-पक्ष, -पाश, -हस्त m. much (or ornamented) hair, तं केशपाशं प्रसमीक्ष्य कुर्युर्बालप्रियत्वं शिथिलं चमर्यः K.S.i.48, vii.57, (पाशः पक्षश्च हस्तश्च कालापार्थः कचात्परे Am.)

केश-बंध m. a hairband.
केश-भू, -भूमि f. the head or any other part of the body where hair grows.
केश-भू, -भूमि f. the head or any other part of the body where hair grows.
केश-प्रसाधनी f. a comb.
केश-मार्जक n. a comb.
केश-मार्जन n. a comb.
केश-रचना f. dressing the hair.
केश-वेश m. a tress or fillet of hair.
केशट m. 1. A goat; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 3. a bug; 4. a brother.
केशव (I) a. (f. वा) See केशिक.
केशव (II) m. An epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa, Bg.i.30.
केशव (I) a. (f. वा) See केशिक.
केशव-आयुध (I) m. the mango tree.
केशव-आयुध (II) n. a weapon of Viṣṇu.
केशव-आलय, -आवास m. the aśvattha tree.
केशव-आलय, -आवास m. the aśvattha tree.
केशिक a. (f. की) Having fine or luxuriant hair.
केशिक a. (f. की) Having fine or luxuriant hair.
केशिन् m. 1. A lion; 2. name of a Rākṣasa slain by Kṛṣṇa; 3. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa; 4. one having fine hair.
केशिन्-निषूदन, -मथन m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa, Bg.xviii.1.
केशिन्-निषूदन, -मथन m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa, Bg.xviii.1.
केशिनी f. A woman with a beautiful braid of hair.

केस(श)र (I) m.n. 1. The mane (of a lion), e.g. मृगपतिरिव स्कंधावलंबितकेशरमालः Kad.; 2. the filament of a flower, नीपं दृष्ट्वा हरित्तकपिशं केसरैरर्धरूढैः Megh.i.21, R.iv.67, Sis.ix.47; 3. the bakula tree, रक्ताशोकश्चलकिसलयः केसरश्चात्र कांतः Megh.ii.15, K.S.ii.55; 4. the punnāga tree.
केस(श)र (II) n. A flower of the bakula tree, R.ix.36.

केस(श)र-अचल m. an epithet of the Mountain Meru.
केस(श)र-अचल m. an epithet of the Mountain Meru.
केस(श)र-वर n. saffron.
केस(श)र-वर n. saffron.

केस(श)रिन् m. 1. A lion, धनुर्धरः केसरिणं ददर्श R.ii.29, पुरुषकेसरिणश्च पुरा नखैः Sak.vii. (fig. used as the last member of a compound, it means ‘best, excellent’); 2. a horse; 3. the citron plant; 4. the punnāga tree; 5. name of the father of Hanūmat.
